title: Room-by-Room Completion
dataSources: Renovation tasks (`reno:task`), budget and receipts (`reno:budget`), material orders (`reno:material`), inspections (`reno:inspection`), contractor logs (`reno:contractor`).
app: Home-renovation project management — task boards (Trello, Notion), budget and receipt trackers, material orders, and inspection / permit logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=reno:task
| stats sum(eval(if(status="done",1,0))) as done, count as total by room
| eval completion_pct=round(100*done/total,1)
| sort completion_pct
description: Shows how finished each room is so you can see what is nearly done and what has barely started.
value: A room-level view helps you push one space to fully finished — and liveable — rather than leaving everything half-done.
implementation: Ingest tasks tagged by room into `index=personal`; compute completion per room.
visualization: Bar chart of completion percentage by room.
grandmaExplanation: It shows how done each room is, so you can finish one space properly instead of leaving the whole house half-done.
